Class ConcurrencyThrottleSupport

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.util.ConcurrencyThrottleSupport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ConcurrencyThrottleInterceptor, SyncTaskExecutor
public abstract class ConcurrencyThrottleSupport extends Object implements Serializable
Support class for throttling concurrent access to a specific resource.

设计用作基类，子类在其工作流的适当点调用beforeAccess()和afterAccess()方法。请注意，afterAccess通常应在finally块中调用！

此支持类的默认并发限制为 UNBOUNDED_CONCURRENCY。子类可以覆盖此默认值；请检查您所使用的具体类的 javadoc。

Since:
1.2.5
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller

    • UNBOUNDED_CONCURRENCY

      public static final int UNBOUNDED_CONCURRENCY
      Concurrency limit which signals unbounded concurrency: -1.

      将此值设置为该限制允许任意数量的并发调用：即不会进行并发节流。

      See Also:

    • NO_CONCURRENCY

      public static final int NO_CONCURRENCY
      Concurrency limit which signals that concurrency throttling has been disabled: 0.

      将此限制设置为该值将阻止所有调用。

  • Method Details

    • setConcurrencyLimit

      public void setConcurrencyLimit(int concurrencyLimit)
      Set the maximum number of concurrent access attempts allowed. The default of -1 indicates no concurrency limit at all.

      原则上，此限制可以在运行时更改，尽管它通常被设计为配置时设置。

      注意：运行时不要在 -1 和任何具体限制值之间切换，因为这会导致不一致的并发计数：-1 的限制实际上会完全关闭并发计数。

    • getConcurrencyLimit
